The teacher leaned against the desk, a warm smile playing on her lips as she handed back the paper. "You really outdid yourself with this one," she said, her voice soft but firm. "The depth of your analysis is impressive."

The student took the paper, eyes scanning the comments, a flush of pride rising to their cheeks. "I stayed up late refining the argument," they admitted, a hint of nervousness in their tone. "I wasn't sure if it was too complex, but I'm glad it came through."

The teacher nodded, her expression encouraging. "It wasn't just complex; it was insightful. Keep this momentum going."

A common crow is black.
